Tabs

Purpose: switch between associated panels in place. Automatic

Purpose: switch between associated panels in place. Automatic activation — arrows move AND select, so focus, selection, and content never disagree.

Usage

<div data-sq-tabs>
  <div class="sq-tablist" role="tablist" aria-label="Project views">
    <button
      class="sq-tab"
      role="tab"
      type="button"
      aria-controls="tab-overview"
      aria-selected="true"
    >
      Overview
    </button>
    <button
      class="sq-tab"
      role="tab"
      type="button"
      aria-controls="tab-activity"
      aria-selected="false"
      tabindex="-1"
    >
      Activity
    </button>
    <button
      class="sq-tab"
      role="tab"
      type="button"
      aria-controls="tab-settings"
      aria-selected="false"
      tabindex="-1"
    >
      Settings
    </button>
  </div>
  <section class="sq-tabpanel" role="tabpanel" id="tab-overview" tabindex="0">
    <p class="sq-text">…</p>
  </section>
  <section class="sq-tabpanel" role="tabpanel" id="tab-activity" hidden>
    …
  </section>
  <section class="sq-tabpanel" role="tabpanel" id="tab-settings" hidden>
    …
  </section>
</div>
<script>
  Squircle.initTabs();
</script>

data-sq-tabs binds the tablist (createTabs(el) for explicit use). Missing tab ids are generated (sq-tab-N); missing aria-labelledby on panels is backfilled. Explicit ids preferred.

Keyboard

Left/Right (Up/Down) select the neighbor with wrapping; Home/End jump; click selects and focuses. tabindex roves (selected tab is 0, the rest -1), so Tab enters the set once, not once per tab.

Panels

Panels hide with hidden — out of the tab order AND the accessibility tree, no ARIA needed. Give scrollable panels tabindex="0"; static panels need no tabindex. Long tab labels never wrap: the tablist scrolls horizontally (overflow-x: auto) instead of squeezing.

Accessibility

  • aria-selected mirrors selection; aria-controls/aria-labelledby

bind tabs to panels (generated when omitted, explicit preferred).

  • Never skip heading levels to fake tab size; never use tabs for

sequential steps (that is a stepper, later stage) or for navigation between pages (those are links).

  • Content under tabs must be reachable another way when it matters

(deep-linking tabs is out of 1.0 scope — document the limitation to users when panels hold shareable content).

Theme behavior

Tab text, hover wash, selected wash, and the accent indicator are tokens; the indicator clears 3:1 against both themes' washes (non-text). Selected state pairs the indicator with aria-selected — never color alone.

Responsive behavior

Labels truncate by scroll, not by ellipsis: the tablist scrolls. Panels reflow like any stacked content. At 360px the set stays one thumb-reachable row — verified, not assumed.

Customization

Override --sq-tab-* tokens or restyle .sq-tab[aria-selected] states in a later stylesheet. Keep the indicator visible in every theme; keep unselected tabs at ≥4.5:1.

Common mistakes

  • Manual activation expectations (arrows move but do not select) —

Squircle tabs are automatic; say so in user docs.

  • hidden replaced with display:none utilities on panels — same

effect, but hidden is the contract the runtime toggles.

  • Tab lists for wizards or page navigation.

Tested limitations

  • No vertical tablists (write page CSS; the runtime is orientation-agnostic).
  • No deep-linking / hash routing for panels.
  • No animated panel transitions (instant swap; reduced-motion safe).
